retained_or_merged.finding: Reorganized as Nine dimensions, one coherent experience; expanded dimension coverage rather than declared lost from heading rename alone.
Relevant continuous-episode verification gained new explicit guidance; no total loss inferred from changed section title.
Headings and representative operative passages persist into v1.12.1; no blocking loss identified in sampled comparison. Not a blanket claim of word-for-word equivalence.

review_limits: Length changes establish pressure, not automatic loss.
A restored phrase may pass a structural test while still failing a consuming agent's task.
Histories retained as referenced source, not copied wholesale.
Migrations to repo-only docs do not count as runtime restoration.
Independent comparative model tests were not run by the historical diff itself.
